common.style_usage: Stardew Valley interior furniture style: warm palette, dark brown outlines, soft wood shading, pixel density and the front-and-top camera of these bedroom furnishings
common.reference_usage: camera angle only: the front face square-on with the top surface visible above it, no side faces

desk.description: one piece of Stardew Valley style furniture for a painting restorer's studio: a wooden work desk with a magnifying lamp on a bent arm, a small cracked landscape painting lying flat on the desk being repaired, tiny solvent bottles and a jar of cotton swabs. Single object, transparent background.

cabinet.description: one piece of Stardew Valley style furniture: a tall narrow wooden cabinet with open shelves of small glass jars full of colorful ground pigment powder (teal, rust red, ochre yellow, violet), a stone mortar and pestle, and a few raw purple amethyst and red ruby crystals. Single object, transparent background.

easel.description: one Stardew Valley style object: a wooden artist's easel holding a canvas turned to face away, so only the plain wooden back of the canvas frame and its cross brace show, a paint rag hanging over one corner. Single object, transparent background.

small.description: one small Stardew Valley style object for a painter's room: a stack of empty ornate gold picture frames leaning together, OR a little round wooden side table with a coffee mug and a glass jar of pink sweet pea flowers, OR a wooden drying rack holding small painted canvases. Single object, transparent background.

rug.description: a Stardew Valley style rug seen from above lying flat on a floor: a rectangular cream canvas drop cloth with frayed edges, splattered and dripped with teal, rust red and ochre paint. Rug only, transparent background.

board.description: a Stardew Valley style wall decoration seen straight on: a wooden-framed cork pinboard covered in pencil sketches of trees and faces, small paint color swatches and a pressed flower. Single object, transparent background.
